outcome: Postpartum depression (PPD) risk, assessed using the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)
finding: Women who underwent unplanned cesarean delivery had a significantly higher risk of screening positive for PPD risk in the immediate postpartum period compared to women who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Unplanned cesarean delivery was an independent risk factor for PPD risk in the immediate postpartum period, while planned CD was not.
